annotations.title: Generate a QR code from a prompt (AI)

description: Generate a QR code where the QR Branding LLM picks colors and shapes from a natural-language prompt. Best for "make me a luxury gold dotted QR for a coffee brand" style requests. This is the one thing local code cannot do at all: a design model picks the palette, module and finder shapes, gradients and framing from the prompt, and the rendered code is then decoded server-side (ISO/IEC 18004) so a stylish result is still a scannable one.

content.description: The text or URL the QR will encode.

logoUrl.description: Optional logo URL to embed at the center.

prompt.description: Natural-language design brief. The engine's LLM will pick colors, shapes, and style hints from this. Example: "luxury gold dots for a coffee brand".

stylePreset.description: Optional style preset name (e.g. "minimal", "luxury", "playful"). Guides the LLM but does not override the design fully.

name: qr_generate_ai

aiExplanation.description: The design model's explanation of its choices, when the engine returns one.

content.description: The text or URL the QR encodes.

filePath.description: PDF in the stdio package only: local temp file the PDF was written to.

format.description: File format the engine rendered: png, svg, jpg, webp or pdf.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the rendered file (the engine's contentType).

resourceUri.description: PDF on the remote server only: URI of the embedded resource block that carries the file.

safeModeApplied.description: True when the AI design did not scan and the engine re-rendered it in safe mode.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the rendered file in bytes, as reported by the engine.

askUser.description: One sentence the assistant can relay when the user needs print, a larger size or a vector file.

formats.description: Formats and sizes a QR Branding API key unlocks.

reason.description: What the keyless trial capped on this call, in one line.

reopenUrl.description: Builder link that reopens this design (templates carry their id).

url.description: Where the same design can be exported as SVG/PDF up to 4K.
